title: KO layout file, version 2
description: Input to the KO generator (docs/contracts/generator.md). Written by the layout builder (generator/configurator/index.html). JSON is also valid YAML, so a KO YAML file with the same fields is equivalent. Version 2 adds the layout style (staggered or grid), several switch types per board and underglow; the page still reads version 1 files.

style.description: staggered: usual row stagger. grid: every key on whole-unit columns (ortholinear); the ISO enter is a 1 x 2 key.

connectivity.description: wireless: USB-C and Bluetooth with battery. wired: USB-C only, no battery fitted.

sockets.description: Hot-swap sockets at every key. mx-choc: one combined footprint for MX-style, Kailh Choc v1 and Choc v2 switches (switch-board contract SWB-001), so types can be mixed per key.

fitted.description: Switch types the owner plans to fit.

feel.description: For the switch order only; does not change the PCB.

case.description: tall when MX switches are fitted (they do not fit the slim case), else slim.

per_key.description: Per-key RGB LEDs and LED driver fitted.

underglow.description: RGB LEDs on the underside of the switch board, lighting the desk around the keyboard.

matrix.description: The generator assigns rows (at most 8) and shift-register columns.

blocks.description: Extra key rows (top) and columns (left, right) added in the builder. Index 1 is next to the main block.

keys.description: Every key. Positions and sizes in units of unit_mm; origin at the top-left of the whole key area, y grows towards the user. A key's switch sits at the centre of its rectangle; for shape iso-enter (bounding box 1.5 x 2 u, top part 1.5 u wide, lower part 1.25 u wide and right-aligned) the switch sits at (x + 0.875, y + 1). Keys 2 u or wider, and tall keys other than the ISO enter, get stabilizers.

code.description: Default keycode, QMK/Vial name; null for an unassigned or custom extra key.

action.description: Extra keys only: the function chosen in the builder, or custom (label set by the user, macro recorded later), or null (blank key).
